question_text: A 48-year-old woman comes to the physician because of a 6-month history of excessive fatigue and a 1-month history of progressively increasing generalized pruritus. She has hypothyroidism, for which she receives thyroid replacement therapy. Physical examination shows jaundice. The liver is palpated 4 cm below the right costal margin. Serum studies show a direct bilirubin concentration of 2.9 mg/dL, alkaline phosphatase activity of 580 U/L, and increased titers of antimitochondrial antibodies and anti-thyroid peroxidase antibodies. Which of the following is the most likely cause of this patient's condition?
